subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Which session and requester identifiers may the macOS approval popup display by default, and what redaction is required for channel/account/thread values?
rationale: The source proves a straightforward session-parity gap, but the fuller requested requester context crosses a local security-prompt disclosure boundary that code inspection cannot safely choose.

options.title: Show session only now
options.body: Render the existing non-empty `sessionKey` as a Session row and defer requester metadata until a disclosure contract is approved.

options.title: Approve a redacted requester contract
options.body: Define a minimal display-safe channel and sender representation, then carry only those fields through the native request model with focused coverage.

options.title: Keep the popup execution-only
options.body: Decline requester disclosure in the native dialog and rely on the existing channel/web approval surfaces for that context.

recommendation.title: Show session only now
recommendation.body: Render the existing non-empty `sessionKey` as a Session row and defer requester metadata until a disclosure contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work is closest to the approval metadata and forwarding contract that determines what the native client can receive.
